# Variables the models can request

*Generated by Claude.*

Every field WW3, MOM6 and CICE can import, where the MESACLIP setup gets it, and what a standard
CESM configuration supplies. The MESACLIP setup is DATM%MESACLIP (6-hourly atmosphere),
DOCN%MESACLIP (daily ocean) and DICE%MESACLIP (daily ice fraction). Line links go to the cap at the
version in `CESM_crocodash`. Scalar (grid-size) fields are left out. Hover over any variable name
for its full name and units. CMEPS (`esmFldsExchange_cesm_mod.F90`) decides what connects.

**Flags:** fields with no flag are read directly from MESACLIP, at most with a unit conversion, or
come from somewhere else, as the EXPLANATION column says.

- {bdg-info}`computed`: calculated in the `mesaclip` datamode from other MESACLIP variables.
- {bdg-primary}`h4`: read from `cam.h4`, the 6-hourly means. All other atmosphere fields come from
  the `cam.h2` 6-hourly snapshots. Radiation (`FLDS`, `FSDS`, `SOLSD`, `SOLLD`) and the
  precipitation components (`PRECC`, `PRECSC`, `PRECSL`) are only saved in h4. `PRECT` is in both
  and is read from h4, so the rain/snow split uses a total and components averaged over the same
  window. The means are stamped at the end of their window, so these streams use `nearest` with a
  −3 h offset ([stream parameters](stream_construction.md#stream-parameters)).

**Prefixes:** `Sa_`, `Faxa_` atmosphere · `So_`, `Fioo_` ocean · `Si_`, `Fioi_` ice · `Sw_` wave ·
`Foxx_`, `Sf_` merged by CMEPS.

**EXPLANATION:** which MESACLIP variable is used, any calculation, and where in the Fortran source
(file:line): `datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`, `docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90` or
`dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`. Ice and ocean names were checked in HIST member 010's daily files
only.

**JRA / CPLHIST:** shorthand for the full configuration, not just the DATM mode. "JRA" = DATM%JRA (atmosphere from JRA reanalysis) + DOCN%SST (observed SST) + DICE%SSMI (SSM/I satellite ice) — three separate data products. "CPLHIST" = DATM%CPLHIST + DOCN%CPLHIST + DICE%CPLHIST, all replayed from a prior coupled run. For DATM fields, the relevant source code is `datm_datamode_jra_mod.F90` or `datm_datamode_cplhist_mod.F90`. For DOCN/DICE fields, the DATM mode is irrelevant; only the DOCN/DICE mode matters.

## WW3

| Import | Meaning | EXPLANATION | JRA | CPLHIST | Standard source | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Sa_u10m`, `Sa_v10m` | 10 m wind | `UBOT`, `VBOT` from `cam.h2`, the lowest-level winds, used as 10 m winds; no 6-hourly `U10` components in HIST; the lowest CAM level is ~60 m so winds are biased high (`datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90:L283–284`). | stand-in: `Sa_u`/`Sa_v` (lowest-level wind, `datm_datamode_jra_mod.F90:L288–289`) | not exported | DATM | [206–207](ww3:L206-L207) |
| `Sa_tbot` | Air temperature | `TREFHT` (2 m temperature) from `cam.h2`, a stand-in for lowest-level temperature, which MESACLIP doesn't save 6-hourly (`datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90:L269`). | direct lowest-level T from stream (`datm_datamode_jra_mod.F90:L276`) | direct | DATM | [205](ww3:L205) |
| `So_t` | SST | `SST` (°C) from `pop.h.nday1`; DOCN adds `TkFrz` (273.15 K) to convert to Kelvin (`docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90:L178–180`). | DOCN%SST | DOCN%CPLHIST | DOCN or MOM6 | [204](ww3:L204) |
| `So_u`, `So_v` | Surface current | `U1_1`, `V1_1` (cm/s) from `pop.h.nday1`, uppermost layer; DOCN multiplies by 0.01 to convert to m/s (`docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90:L148,L155`); still on POP tripole grid U-points, not rotated to geographic east/north. | DOCN%SST (currents not provided — stub zero) | DOCN%CPLHIST | DOCN or MOM6 | [202–203](ww3:L202-L203) |
| `So_bldepth` | Ocean boundary-layer depth | Not supplied. DOCN sends `shr_const_spval` (fill) when no stream is present (`docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90:L164`); WW3 runs but Langmuir outputs (`Sw_lamult`, `Sw_hstokes`) receive fill — these require `LMPN=T`, which is off by default and not set in the Alaska case. | not supplied | not supplied | MOM6 | [208–210](ww3:L208-L210) |
| `Si_ifrac` | Ice fraction | `aice_d` (%) from `cice.h1`; DICE divides by 100 to convert to fraction (`dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90:L408`). | DICE%SSMI (SSM/I satellite) | DICE%CPLHIST or CICE | CICE or DICE | [200](ww3:L200) |
| `Si_thick` | Ice thickness | Not supplied; DICE%SSMI also does not provide it. Candidate: `hi_d` ÷ (`aice_d`/100) from CICE history. | not supplied (DICE%SSMI also omits) | CICE only | CICE | [201](ww3:L201) |
| `Si_floediam` | Floe diameter | Not supplied; DICE%SSMI also does not provide it; requires CICE. | not supplied | not supplied | CICE | [211–213](ww3:L211-L213) |
